0022600152.text: The Spurs (3-2, on a three-game winning streak, 1-2 at home and 2-0 on the road) host the Timberwolves (4-2, on a one-game winning streak, 2-1 at home and 2-1 on the road) in San Antonio's sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with San Antonio 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, and eighth in the West, while Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and sixth in the West. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), and Stephon Castle is day-to-day with a mild head injury and is a game-time decision, while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Rudy Gobert is day-to-day with back spasms and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a playoff game in Minneapolis on May 15, which the Spurs won 139-109, following a 1-2 Spurs loss in the 2025-26 regular season series and a 4-2 Spurs win in the 2025-26 playoffs.
